mapper.insert: INSERT INTO proactive_prompt_events ( id, user_id, prompt_date, prompt_id, fingerprint, source, prompt_text, related_date, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{promptDate}, #{promptId}, #{fingerprint}, #{source}, #{promptText}, #{relatedDate}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE prompt_id = VALUES(prompt_id), source = VALUES(source), prompt_text = VALUES(prompt_text), related_date = VALUES(related_date), status = IF(status IN ('answered', 'dismissed', 'selected'), status, VALUES(status)), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, prompt_date, prompt_id, fingerprint, source, prompt_text, related_date, status, created_at, updated_at FROM proactive_prompt_events WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND prompt_date >= #{since} ORDER BY updated_at DESC

SELECT id, user_id, prompt_date, prompt_id, fingerprint, source, prompt_text, related_date, status, created_at, updated_at FROM proactive_prompt_events WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND source = 'followup' AND status IN ('shown', 'selected') ORDER BY prompt_date DESC
